description: Watch one sold Derive or Paradex put to expiry and, if it is assigned, buy the asset it agreed to buy.

VENUE.description: The venue the put trades on: derive (the default) or paradex. Both settle in cash, which is why the asset has to be bought. Not rysk: an assigned Rysk put delivers the asset itself, so options-lifecycle watches it.

INSTRUMENT.description: The venue's own name for the put, exactly as it was filled: ETH-20261030-2450-P on Derive, ETH-USD-30OCT26-2450-P on Paradex. The expiry is read back out of this, so it must match the fill.

UNDERLYING.description: The asset ticker, the prefix of INSTRUMENT: ETH, BTC, SOL, HYPE or any other currency the venue lists options on. Used for the settlement read on Derive.

TOKEN_ID.description: The token the delivery buy trades, pinned from the /token-search row for UNDERLYING when the duty is filed: native:<chainId> for a chain's coin (ETH on Base is native:8453), <address>:<chainId> for a token such as cbBTC.

STRIKE.description: The price the owner agreed to buy at.

SIZE.description: Contracts sold, in units of the underlying.

PREMIUM_USD.description: What the owner kept at open, net of the venue's fee (the open's netPremiumUsd). Quoted back at expiry.

COLLATERAL_USD.description: USDC locked behind the put, as the open reported it (collateral). The most an assigned buy can cost, so the pocket is sized from it.

HEADS_UP_HOURS.description: How long before expiry to send the heads-up. Sent once.
